experimental_unit: one (held_out_family, capacity) instance -- NOT individual requests. 7 families x 3 capacities = 21 paired instances per objective. Requests within one instance are sequentially dependent (cache state carries forward), never treated as independent replicates.
comparison_design: paired: all 4 objectives (eviction_loss, next_arrival, reuse_distance, pairwise) are scored on the identical 21 (held_out_family, capacity) instances under the identical held-out evaluation protocol, so differences are computed per-instance.
reported_statistics: wins_ties_losses (alternative strictly lower / equal / strictly higher miss_ratio than eviction_loss, per instance)

inferential_test.primary_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank test, two-sided, for each of the 3 alternative objectives (next_arrival, reuse_distance, pairwise) vs. the eviction_loss reference, paired on the same 21 instances
inferential_test.omnibus_robustness_check: Friedman test across all 4 objectives as a robustness check on the primary pairwise results -- not a substitute for them
inferential_test.rationale: 21 paired, non-independent-request instances per objective; matches the paired design already frozen for Concern 1 (configs/reviewer_fairness_statistics.json) for consistency across the campaign
inferential_test.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the 3 primary pairwise comparisons (vs. eviction_loss)
inferential_test.effect_size: matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation, reported alongside each p-value
inferential_test.confidence_intervals: bootstrap (10,000 resamples over the 21 paired instances) 95% CI on the mean miss-ratio difference

explicit_prohibitions: Do not treat the 40,000 scored requests within one (family, capacity) instance as independent replicates for any test.
Do not select which objective comparisons to report after viewing results.
Do not change the test, correction, or threshold after viewing any objective's held-out results.

Do not compute statistics until the same-example audit and fairness audit both report FINAL=true PASS -- a statistically significant difference computed over a non-fairness-audited comparison is not evidence of anything.
